title: When is a System Discoverable from Data? Discovery Requires Chaos
abstract: arXiv:2511.08860v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The deep learning revolution has enabled major AI advances in physical sciences, particularly in discovering dynamical systems from observational data. Yet the reliability of learned surrogates and symbolically discovered models is often undermined by non-uniqueness: models may fit observed trajectories perfectly, but lack genuine predictive power. We show that chaos, despite its association with unpredictability, is often what makes governing equations discoverable. We prove that the classical Lorenz system is analytically discoverable and verify experimentally that for many systems out-of-domain generalization emerges precisely at chaos onset. Conservative systems, by contrast, are inherently non-discoverable from data alone. The prevalence of chaotic systems in benchmarks may have inadvertently obscured this limitation. translated_title: 什么时候系统能从数据中被发现？发现需要混沌
translated_abstract: 深度学习革命推动了物理科学领域的重大人工智能进展，特别是在从观测数据中发现动力系统方面。然而，学习到的代理模型和符号发现模型的可靠性常常受到非唯一性的损害：模型可能完美拟合观测轨迹，却缺乏真正的预测能力。我们证明，尽管混沌与不可预测性相关联，但它往往正是使控制方程可被发现的关键。我们证明了经典洛伦兹系统在分析上是可发现的，并通过实验验证，对于许多系统而言，域外泛化能力恰好在混沌出现时产生。相比之下，保守系统在本质上无法仅凭数据被发现。基准测试中混沌系统的普遍存在可能无意中掩盖了这一局限性。这些发现有助于解释为什么人工智能擅长天气预报，却在许多工程应用中表现不佳。
tldr: 混沌虽然与不可预测性相关，却往往是使动力系统控制方程能够从数据中被发现的关键——系统的域外泛化能力恰好在混沌出现时产生，而保守系统本质上无法仅凭数据被发现。
en_tdlr: Chaos, despite its association with unpredictability, is often what makes governing equations discoverable from data—out-of-domain generalization emerges precisely at chaos onset, while conservative systems are inherently non-discoverable from data alone.
